gen-gf-yuji-hentaigana-akari-fs-rowan: Big gaps between its hand-drawn letters make Yuji Hentaigana Akari feel relaxed. Rowan, a text serif, thins out gently below it, which suits big, short headings and leaves the body text to itself.
gen-gf-yuji-hentaigana-akari-fs-spline-s: Spline Sans reads wide open and modern, with gaps where curves meet stems. Next to the loose handwriting of Yuji Hentaigana Akari, its uniform strokes give the pair a friendly, crisp tension.
gen-gf-yuji-hentaigana-akari-fs-synonym: Synonym lays down a plain sans line of constant ink, with generous openings in every curve. And Yuji Hentaigana Akari brings the personal, hand-drawn side, which is why brief copy suits this pairing best.
gen-gf-yuji-hentaigana-akari-outfit: Yuji Hentaigana Akari writes with a relaxed, hand-drawn looseness, while Outfit sets smooth, tube-like sans-serif lines beneath it. Past a few lines, the tidy body tires.
gen-gf-yuji-hentaigana-akari-plus-jakart: Plus Jakarta Sans keeps its curve endings well apart and draws every line as a single monoline channel, against the personal handwriting of Yuji Hentaigana Akari. Over a longer stretch, it gets stiff.
gen-gf-yuji-hentaigana-akari-sora: Sora reads precise and geometric, its curves turning corners with no swell and its c and s held widely parted. Sora gives the loose, personal hand of Yuji Hentaigana Akari a steady marker-like line to lean on.
gen-gf-yuji-hentaigana-akari-space-grote: Yuji Hentaigana Akari is personal and relaxed, drawn by hand with big gaps between its letters. Space Grotesk follows in a sans-serif ribbon of constant width, and a longer passage would feel tidy but tiring.
gen-gf-yuji-hentaigana-akebono-fs-amulya: Yuji Hentaigana Akebono brings casual, friendly handwriting with plenty of room between letters, set above a modern sans body. Longer text stays open.
gen-gf-yuji-hentaigana-akebono-fs-neco: Friendly and inviting, Yuji Hentaigana Akebono writes like pen on paper, while Neco, a serif with a measured swell, adds dignity below. The handwriting earns its place big and short.
gen-gf-yuji-hentaigana-akebono-fs-plein: Inviting handwriting leads in Yuji Hentaigana Akebono, with room between each casual letter. Plein, a plain sans, gives each round letter a clear channel, so a longer passage stays reliable and clean.
